scoring_justification: Recomputation from raw layer stiffness tensors is infeasible in the verifier sandbox (requires full homogenization solver); comparing the agent's reported output to the paper's own hierarchical model predictions (Table 11) with tolerances is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for E11 and E22 from the paper's hierarchical model predictions.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reference numbers the paper's own model produced; they are not invented.

outputs.description: Predicted effective moduli for three CG-FRP validation cases. The checker compares these values to hidden reference values (paper-reported model predictions) within prescribed relative tolerances and verifies a monotonic trend of E11 with respect to fiber volume fraction.

output_contract.notes: The agent must choose appropriate discretization (N>=10) and derive the CNT areal density for the higher-Vcnt cases from the volume fraction relation to achieve the stated CNT volume fractions. The gold reference is the paper's own hierarchical model predictions, not experimental data.

steps.description: Verify that E11 increases with fiber volume fraction: E11(Vf0.3) < E11(Vf41) < E11(Vf67).
